content: अविपक्व {%a.%} Not ripe (<ab>fig.</ab> also); immature, undigested; ˚बुद्धि inexperienced, of undeveloped understanding. .{@-करण@} {%a.%} Having immature or undeveloped organs; तथाऽविपक्वकरण आत्मज्ञानस्य न क्षमः <ls>Y. 3. 141</ls>. .{@-बुद्धि@} {%a.%} Having an immature or inexperienced mind.
